headline: Westinghouse Air Brake Technologies (WAB) Is Up 16.7% After Buyback-Fueled EPS Lift And Dividend Affirmation
summary: Westinghouse Air Brake Technologies recently completed a share repurchase of 9,068,721 shares for US$1.68 billion and reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of US$3,179 million with net income of US$395 million, alongside affirming a quarterly dividend of US$0.31 per share. The combination of earnings growth, continued capital returns through buybacks and dividends, and improved per-share profitability offers fresh context for how investors may view Wabtec’s rail-focused business model.
